breakdown.description: The prompt uses the polar moment J in the Euler buckling formula, even though Euler buckling depends on the flexural second moment I.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still uses the polar moment J = π d⁴/32 in the Euler buckling formula (P_cr = π² E J / (KL)²). The ground truth requires the second moment of area I = π d⁴/64. The agent repeated the original error rather than correcting it.

breakdown.description: The prompt multiplies the critical load by the factor of safety to obtain the allowable load, whereas the allowable load should be the critical load divided by the factor of safety.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly computes the allowable load as P_allow = P_cr / n = 17.4 kN / 2 ≈ 8.7 kN, which matches the ground truth's intent of dividing by the factor of safety rather than multiplying.
